description: This file contains wrappers and utilities for exporting and tracing PyTorch modules, including decorators for making subclasses traceable in export, handling submodules, and managing custom autograd functions during export.

classes.name: ExportTracepoint
classes.description: A higher-order operator class used for tracing export points in the model.

methods.name: export_tracepoint_dispatch_mode
methods.description: Handles export tracepoint for ProxyTorchDispatchMode by creating a proxy and tracking tensor tree.

methods.name: export_tracepoint_fake_tensor_mode
methods.description: Handles export tracepoint for FakeTensorMode by executing within the mode context.

methods.name: export_tracepoint_functional
methods.description: Functionalize export tracepoint, unwrapping tensors and redispatching.

methods.name: export_tracepoint_cpu
methods.description: Export tracepoint for CPU dispatch key, returns args as-is.

methods.name: mark_subclass_constructor_exportable_experimental
methods.description: Decorator to make subclass tensor constructors traceable in export with pre-dispatch IR.

methods.name: allow_in_pre_dispatch_graph
methods.description: Decorator to add functions to export pre-dispatch graph, supporting custom autograd functions and subclass constructors.
